{{Top|leg}}
A '''photoreactive fiber''' was an item of technology that could be added to a suit. The [[camo scout armor]] from [[Creshaldyne Industries/Legends|Creshaldyne Industries]] included miniature photoreactive fibers embedded within it. The fibers allowed the armor to absorb light around it, changing its color to match anything around it.
